title: Abigail
lead: The wise wife of Nabal of Maon who turned David from bloodshed and, after Nabal's death, became David's wife and the mother of his son Chileab (also called Daniel). A different Abigail was David's sister.

sections.b: Abigail appears in one long story (1 Samuel 25) and a few later notices. She rides out to meet David's war band, takes the blame for her husband's insult, and in a long speech foretells David's lasting house and keeps him from shedding innocent blood. After Nabal's death she marries David. She is captured with Ahinoam in the raid on Ziklag and rescued (1 Samuel 30:5, 18), goes up with David to Hebron (2 Samuel 2:2), and bears his second son, called Chileab in Samuel and Daniel in Chronicles (2 Samuel 3:3; 1 Chronicles 3:1). David's sister, also named Abigail, was the mother of Amasa (2 Samuel 17:25; 1 Chronicles 2:16–17).
